data.one_liner: Customizable single/multiple select box with search, groups, extra info, and avatars.
data.what_it_does: Select2dot1 provides a dropdown select box widget supporting single and multiple selections, search functionality, categorized groups, avatars, and custom builders. It adapts its display mechanism, using overlays on web and desktop, and modals on mobile devices.
use_when: You need a robust single or multi-select dropdown with search and category grouping.
You require platform-adaptive behavior using overlays on desktop/web and modals on mobile.
avoid_when: You are looking for a standard form field integrated deeply with Form validation without extra UI customization.
You want a pure Material Design dropdown without custom avatars or rich items.
strengths: Supports search, avatars, extra info, and grouped options.
Platform-adaptive UI (overlay for desktop/web, modal for mobile).
Extensively customizable through global settings, single component settings, and builders.
weaknesses: Limited to select box components rather than general form building.
Customizing deeply requires navigating a structured component hierarchy.
data.minimal_example:
Select2dot1(
    selectDataController: SelectDataController(data: exampleData),
    scrollController: scrollController,
)
